item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q019_stable_periodic_release_semantics","answer":"The current-release endpoint reports SCOPe version 2.08 with stable label 2.08-stable. Its latest periodic update is 2.08-2026-08-16, dated 2026-08-16. For a reproducible SCOPe analysis, cite and pin the stable release identifier 2.08-stable / release 2.08 rather than treating the periodic label as a new comprehensive SCOPe release. The dated 2.08-2026-08-16 label identifies the latest periodic refresh layered on the 2.08 release stream; it is release-specific public update metadata, not a new fold/family-level evolutionary assertion and not a license to transfer homology, function, templates, or representatives beyond the SCOPe family/superfamily/fold/class limits recorded for the underlying domains.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope.get_scop_service_info","/api/v1/","/api/v1/releases/current"]}]}
